# SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectrumLevelStatistics

Module: **Spin** · directory: `Spin/src/Programs` · binary: `Spin/src/Programs/SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectrumLevelStatistics`

Manual: [SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectrumLevelStatistics (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectrumLevelStatistics.md)

```text
SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectrumLevelStatistics, version 0.01

Usage: SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectrumLevelStatistics [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -s, --spectra : name of the file that contains the binary entanglement spectra
    --window-min : set the index of the first entanglement spectrum to consider (default value = 0)
    --window-max :  set the index of the last entanglement spectrum to consider (negative if up to the last available entanglement spectrum) (default value = -1)
    --min-entenergy : reject all entanglement energies below a given energy (default value = 0)
    --max-entenergy :  reject all entanglement energies above a given energy (negative if no cut-off should be applied) (default value = -1)
    --fixed-sza : focus on a single SzA sector
    --sza-value : if the option --fixed-sza is turned on, indicate which SzA sector should be considered (default value = 0)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : name of the output file where the density of states will be stored (if none, try to deduce it from either --spectra replacing the dat extension with dos/levelstat)
    --nbr-bins : number of bins for the density of states (default value = 100)
    --bin-spacing : spacing range for each bin for the level statistics (default value = 0.10000000000000001)
    --discard-outputfiles : do not save any results on disk, just display the summary using the standard output
    --extract-singlespectrum : extract a single entanglement spectrum from --spectra instead of computing level statistics (default value = -1)
    --only-rvalues : only compute the average ratio of adjacent gaps for each entanglement spectrum

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
